text:
Maria P.: Heads-up: 20x H100 (order #NEX-4502) arrived at SFO overnight but the dock flagged 3 units as damaged and 2 units with serials not matching packing list. Photos uploaded: https://redwood-internal/snap/IMG_2345.jpg. AWB `AWB123456789`. Tracking shows customs held one crate for HS code mismatch. Need vendor replacement and backfill ETA. @Oliver_Nexa can you confirm?

Oliver N.: Hi Maria — sorry, saw this. Reviewing photos now. Can you DM the packing manifest? we'll open a replacement shipment but need confirm on whether you want air expedite or ground (cost diff).

Maria P.: Sent manifest in DM. Prefer air expedite for 3 DOA, keep the 2 serials in quarantine until we verify. cc: @Sophie_L.

Sophie L.: On it. I'll coordinate depot inspection today. If vendor sends air, we can do overnight handoff to our staging bay. Quick Q: do we claim insurance for the crate with customs hold? looks like value > $250k.

Oliver N.: Yes we can file insurer claim. But customs documentation needs HS code 8542.31 — vendor used 8542.32 by mistake. We can refile, but that'll add ~48h unless customs accepts electronic amendment. I can push for amendment.

Tom B.: From ops: please tag the 2 suspect serials as `quarantine-SFO-2357992468`. I'll block them from pool and trigger a serial audit. Also need to know whether to allocate replacements from our reserved EU pool vs US hot spares.

Ajay K.: Cost note: if vendor ships ASAP via air, vendor covers freight. If we backfill from EU hotspares, finance will charge transfer recovery to procurement budget at current fx rate. Preference?

Maria P.: Vendor air preferred. Oliver, can you confirm earliest ship date and upload AWB draft? Also need replacement SKU and firmware parity note.

Oliver N.: Can ship earliest tomorrow by air (ETA 48h). AWB draft attached: `AWB-DRAFT-235799`. Replacement units are H100-256GB-REF, firmware v2.1. We'll include manifest with serials matching.

Sophie L.: Great — please send customs amendment request now. I'll book our staging bay for Friday morning 06:00-10:00. Ops will do physical inspection and IMEI/serial reconciliation.

Maria P.: :thumbsup: When AWB is live, ping here and I'll approve expedite. Also, we will submit insurance claim for the damaged crate. Oliver, can you confirm insurer contact and claim ref?

Oliver N.: Insurer is GlobalFreightClaims. Claim ref will be created once vendor confirms amendment. Tentative claim ref `GFC-987654`. We'll update by EOD.

Tom B.: Note for SRE: keep cluster affinity limits until replacements verified. I'll throttle scheduling on the impacted pool so tasks don't land on suspect cards.

Ajay K.: :money_with_wings: Finance will pre-approve emergency transfer if vendor covers freight; otherwise hold until claim processed. Please add invoice instructions to the AWB.

Maria P.: Thanks all. Summary: vendor to amend customs, ship air tomorrow, staging inspection Friday, quarantine 2 units, backfill 3 DOA. I'll reconcile costs later. Closing here once AWB + claim ref are in thread.
